title: Chicken Noodle Soup
subtitle: Proper home-made broth with egg noodles
excerpt: A whole chicken simmered low and slow to produce a clear, golden broth, then finished with egg noodles, carrots, and celery. The kind of soup that takes the best part of an afternoon and rewards every minute.

recipe.sourceNotes: Chicken noodle soup in the UK is a simplified version of the Jewish-American and Eastern European traditions that brought it to prominence. The British version uses egg noodles rather than fine soup noodles, and relies on a whole poached chicken for the broth rather than pre-made stock. The key technique is to keep the broth at a very gentle simmer throughout so it stays clear. Skim the scum from the surface during the first 30 minutes of cooking.

recipeTools.notes: Large enough to hold a whole chicken with room for water to cover it.

content.text: The broth must stay below a rolling boil throughout: a hard boil makes the fat emulsify into the stock and turns it cloudy and greasy. Keep it at the point where small bubbles rise slowly to the surface. Skim the grey scum from the top during the first 30 minutes. Adding the noodles at the end prevents them from becoming waterlogged.

content.text: Put the whole chicken into the stockpot breast-side down. Add the 2 whole carrots, 2 whole celery sticks, onion halves, garlic, bay leaves, thyme, and peppercorns. Cover with cold water (about 3 litres). Bring slowly to a very gentle simmer over medium heat. This takes 20 to 25 minutes.

Skim off the grey scum that rises to the surface during the first 20 to 30 minutes. Do not let the broth boil hard. Simmer very gently for 1 hour 30 minutes to 1 hour 45 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and beginning to fall from the bone.
Remove the chicken carefully and set aside to cool slightly. Strain the broth through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean pot. Discard the spent vegetables. Season the broth generously with salt.

Pull the chicken meat from the bones and shred into pieces. Discard the skin and carcass. Bring the broth back to a gentle simmer. Add the sliced carrot and celery and cook for 5 minutes. Add the egg noodles and cook for a further 3 to 4 minutes until tender. Add the shredded chicken. Serve in deep bowls with plenty of parsley.
